interfaces.cli: Native machine-only scoped JSONL batch requests; one compact JSON summary; no MCP
interfaces.gui: Minimal ImGui/Win32/DX11 controls using the same protected adaptive core
interfaces.agent_entry: README_AI.md; optional complete portable project-cleanup Skill with progressive disclosure for Codex/Claude and other Agents
interfaces.cli_default: capabilities; scan is explicit. Quick scan is advisory; overwrite scan can retain a protected resumable plan. Authorized run can prepare and execute one scoped manifest request
interfaces.reports: One compact stdout JSON summary and external detailed records; requested private reports may contain paths, unlike masked retained event logs and bounded GUI diagnostics
interfaces.operator_adoption: Verified official runtime Release ZIP; no automatic source checkout or compilation during cleanup
interfaces.contracts: Unversioned v1 preserved; explicit --contract-version 2 opts into readiness, shared aggregates/phase/space observations and typed guidance; published v2.0.0 remains v1

cleanup_plans: default autonomous cleanup with positive disposability evidence
custom explicit directory or file list

authorization.irreversible_run_authorization: explicit request flag after plan/scope selection
authorization.procedure_boundary: Agent/Skill selects the plan and confirms scope; native code enforces explicit request flags, manifest scope, identity and protection, not a human-dialogue transcript

execution.membership: Complete batch frozen before mutation; additions/replacements excluded
execution.staging: Bounded sorted runs and indexed protected scratch files; compact resource-admitted scheduler metadata
execution.admission: No fixed Quick target-count or 16-worker ceiling; admit the complete batch from live memory/commit, CPU, handle and scratch-disk budgets plus caller limits before mutation
execution.preparation: Bounded independent work with pinned ancestry, per-worker buffers and shared volume facts
execution.scheduling: Shared physical-device groups; unknown topology grouped conservatively; measured concurrency probes require repeated gains and use regression rollback/cooldown; ready child-parent dependencies
execution.failure_recovery: Automatic access/lock recovery and limited retries only after the complete first pass; untouched targets retain explicit pending provenance; automatic force termination forbidden
execution.quick_resume: In-session only; no external plan/report imported as retry authority
execution.crash: Unknown or partial completion; never automatically rescan to discover a replacement batch
execution.outcomes: Paged disk evidence, compact counters, bounded diagnostics; no per-file process startup
execution.system_protection: Core-enforced fail-closed nofollow and fresh identity/protection checks; exact running EXE/module identities and containing ancestors protected, unrelated siblings permitted; OS/service/boot/private-state tree rules remain
execution.resource_loss: Later resource loss or device faults can stop an admitted job after partial deletion; retain quick_not_attempted provenance and a separate stopping_error; never silently truncate or rescan
execution.resident_bound: Target strings/outcomes are file-backed; compact dependency metadata remains proportional to target count and can exceed admission. Engine budgets are not a total process RSS guarantee
execution.resource_observations: CPU/queue/handle availability are conservative observations or estimates, not reserved OS capacity or proof of optimal hardware throughput
execution.statistics: Core-owned unique selected/remove-attempted/completed files/directories/unclassified counts; checked known default-stream snapshot byte sums and unknown-size counts; final failures once after recovery
execution.request_status: Read-only bounded v2 lookup of existing private request reports; ambiguous/missing/partial evidence is not replay or Quick resume authority

semantics.quick: Permanent logical namespace deletion; no payload overwrite/readback or secure-erasure promise; identity and protection checks still apply
semantics.overwrite: Separate verified logical overwrite engine: resident plan, bounded workers/queues, cryptographic stream, full flush/readback verification, authenticated durable checkpoints and explicit downgrade grants; Quick scheduling/storage claims do not apply
semantics.hardlinks: Quick: separate selected names, unselected aliases survive, contents never overwritten. Overwrite: identity dedup selects one deterministic alias; shared data is delete-only with independent approval and retained aliases reported
semantics.space: Observed allocation may prioritize work; free-space observations are not attributable reclaimed-byte guarantees
semantics.steam: No verified private Steam uninstall algorithm is claimed
semantics.filesystem_scope: NTFS/ReFS/FAT32/exFAT targeted; actual capability/protection checks required. Quick may use a conservative common group for unknown storage topology; overwrite rejects unsupported storage evidence. Scope is not a passed hardware matrix

delivery.git: Maintained source/config/docs/assets/tests only; immutable dependency locks
delivery.archive: Source packaging produces an exact-commit, single-root Source ZIP with manifest/SHA256. Published v2.0.0 runtime ZIP instead contains owner GUI/CLI binaries, instructions, complete Skill, operational schemas and licenses; source/build/test files remain in Git
delivery.acceptance: Normal RC/Release gates require scoped owner evidence and review; incomplete hardware/platform coverage prevents a later full Release. Published v2.0.0 uses only the explicit first-distribution exception in docs/publication.md
delivery.current_publication: Published Latest v2.0.0 at source reference 2b552ba92c9e81cb1ef4b8101619993677b5548a; owner EXEs unchanged, still reporting 2.0.0-dev.1; no independently attested source-to-owner-binary binding
delivery.validation_scope: Owner GUI quick/overwrite smoke and a scoped 2,890-file CLI Quick pilot reported successful; native CI 38785317728 passed 11 safe suites, four isolated suites and source packaging on hosted Server 2025. Broader CLI acceptance and full hardware matrix remain pending; see spec/project.json and docs/windows_test_plan.md
